title: Drifting: Pairwise Field and Frozen Targets

provenance.adaptation: Adapts the authors’ Swiss-roll/checkerboard notebook. Reduced from noise32→3×256, batch2048, 2000 steps to noise8→2×48, generated96/positive128, 260 steps and temperature .2 for CPU grading. No pretrained features, CFG, or image benchmarks. Paper Figure 3 is a separate bimodal experiment. The normalized kernel uses logsumexp instead of the notebook’s absolute product floor to avoid common exponential underflow.
